messages:
Maya: Heads up — main CI went red immediately after my PR merged (PR #4321). Pipeline: https://ci.redwood.ai/789

deploy-bot: Pipeline #789 failed on job `smoke-tests` (exit code 1). Logs: /artifacts/789/logs

Alex: on it. which smoke failed?

Maya: smoke-tests -> test_kv_cache::test_eviction_behavior

Devon: I've seen that one flake before. Error snippet from logs: `AssertionError: expected 43 != 42` at test_kv_cache.py:88

Sasha: can you try a rerun? sometimes the cache seed causes this. `./scripts/ci rerun 789` or click rerun in the UI

Devon: I'll trigger rerun now.

deploy-bot: Rerun requested by Devon — new job 790 queued

deploy-bot: Job 790 finished — SUCCESS

Alex: green on rerun. probable transient. I'll file a flaky test ticket and add the test to flaky-suite with a 24h monitor.

Maya: thanks — I'll follow up with a tiny PR to add a stricter fixture seed and note in test metadata

Devon: adding marker: ISSUE-1892

Sasha: :thumbsup: If it pops again we can bisect the PR range, but for now mark as flake and move on

Maya: agreed. sorry for noise — merging follow-up in a few mins

Alex: no worries, thanks for the ping!
